subject: Math
subskill: Effect of Adding/Removing Data on Statistics
prompt: Data set A consists of $7$ numbers. When each number in data set A is increased by $3$, the resulting data set B has a mean of $33$. What is the mean of data set A?
explanation: Choice B is correct. When each value in a data set is increased by a constant, the mean increases by that constant. Since data set B has mean $33$ and was created by adding $3$ to each value in data set A, the mean of A is $33 - 3 = 30$.
